# OnlineSelfSupervisedESN

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An Echo State Network that learns from its own predictions in real-time, using a self-generated target signal rather than labeled data. Supports continuous learning in dynamic environments, critical for in-network neuromorphic processing where data streams are unlabeled.
